source: servo profile refit 2026-09-27 (claude/sim-servo-profile-2000): replayed the robot's own command streams (scripted 2000/80 x3 stances, RL 400/20, RL 800/40, 1400/60, 2000/80; ~/.hexapod/analysis/servo_fit/profile_fit.py) through ServoProfile + first-order servo lag. The 2026-09-21 yaw/hip latency 130/125 ms double-counted the profile ramp (the trapezoid at 400/20 already produces the measured 280-330 ms on RL commands; scripted 2000/80 tracks with <=30 ms). Latency restored to the 2026-08-07 bench values (29.7/25.6/8.6 ms); deadband 0.15/0.15/0.25 deg (fit prefers <=0.15; bench 0.35-0.49 slowed jittery commands); vel_max = 2000 counts/s = the new bus.write_speed default (cfg bus.servo_vel_max_counts_s=write_speed keeps it tied); kp/kv/torque unchanged from the 09-21 refit. Base file kept: sim_model_20260921_refit.json.
